data.narrative:
Newcleo is a Series B nuclear energy company founded by Stefano Buono, Luciano Cinotti, and Elisabeth Rizzotti, having raised $755M to date. The nuclear energy sector contains 11 comparable companies across public and private markets: 3 public peers (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private competitors including Valar Atomics, Helion, X-Energy, and Nano Nuclear Energy.

Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier to the $755M capital raised proxy, reflecting typical valuation expansion from Series B to later stages. This method yields an implied valuation of $1.4B. A peer-median approach was not applicable; while 6 same-sector peers exist, the narrow filter criteria (same stage, adjacent stage, similar valuation tier) returned insufficient data points for reliable triangulation—applying an all-sector median would introduce unacceptable bias.

The quantitative analysis supports a valuation range of $1.2B (low) to $1.6B (high), with a median of $1.4B. This range reflects a single applicable method and therefore carries material execution risk. Key uncertainties include technology readiness level validation, regulatory pathway clarity for advanced reactor designs, capital intensity of commercialization, and time to revenue generation. The narrow comp set in nuclear energy and stage-specific scarcity limit confidence in the range; future fundraising dynamics and peer outcome data will be critical to calibrate this estimate.
